item.title: Laces Out Run Club
item.description:
Thursday, July 30, 2026 at 5:30 PM

Location: Tap Room, 941 W 18TH ST., Houston, TX, 77008, United States

Every Thursday at 5:30 and 6:30 PM, our Laces Out Run Club members start on a route of their choosing, ranging from a 2, 3.5, 5, or 8 mile run. After their run, they receive $2 off beers the rest of the evening! REWARDS 🎽 10 runs: EH headband 🎽 25 runs: Laces Out shirt 🎽 50 runs: Running shorts 🎽 100 runs: Singlet        

From Eureka Heights Brewery

item.title: HSPCA Pinball Fundraiser- Flippers & Puppers
item.description:
Friday, July 31, 2026 at 5:30 PM

Location: Tap Room, 941 W 18TH ST., Houston, TX, 77008, United States

Join us as we raise funds for puppies by playing pinball! We’ll be partnering with the HSPCA for this play in tournament, where you can go head to head in a flipper style competition, while drinking beer, and donating to a great cause. $20 buy in and $2 off beers for participants!

From Eureka Heights Brewery
